## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Verification

List the commands you ran and their results. Start with:

```text
npm run verify
npm run pack:dry-run
```

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior or the PR explains why no test applies.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and configuration are documented.
- [ ] Permission, approval, cancellation, and timeout behavior remain explicit and fail closed.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, commits, and screenshots contain no secrets or private prompts.
- [ ] `package.json` and `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` versions agree when preparing a release.
